scripts.pack:zip: rm -f one-shift-playable.zip && npm run build:crazygames && cd dist/crazygames && zip -9 -r ../../one-shift-playable.zip . -x '.*'
scripts.pack:crazygames: npm run build:crazygames && mkdir -p release && rm -f release/one-shift-crazygames.zip && cd dist/crazygames && zip -9 -r ../../release/one-shift-crazygames.zip . -x '.*'
scripts.pack:web: npm run build:web && mkdir -p release && rm -f release/one-shift-web.zip && cd dist/web && zip -9 -r ../../release/one-shift-web.zip . -x '.*'
scripts.release: npm run pack:crazygames && npm run pack:web
